CVE-2026-118664.title: decode-uri-component: Denial of service via quadratic replacement of percent-encoded runs
CVE-2026-118664.description: decode-uri-component provides a more robust alternative to decodeURIComponent. Prior to 0.5.1, decodeUriComponent in index.js falls back to customDecodeURIComponent after native decoding throws, and the fallback collects every distinct percent-encoded run before performing a full-string regular-expression replacement for each entry. Malformed input containing many distinct runs can therefore make both the number of replacements and the scanned input length grow together, causing quadratic CPU consumption and blocking the Node.js event loop; request-body inputs can reach the demonstrated size, while ordinary URL header limits reduce the practical delay. This issue is fixed in version 0.5.1.

CVE-2026-127064.description: @fastify/reply-from is a Fastify plugin that forwards requests to an upstream HTTP server. In versions before 12.8.4, its buildURL function rejects parent-directory path segments by an exact string match, so a segment that carries a semicolon path parameter, such as a dot-dot segment followed by a semicolon and an optional parameter, is not equal to the plain dot-dot form and passes the traversal check, and the WHATWG URL parser keeps it as an ordinary segment so the base-prefix containment check also passes. Backends that strip semicolon path parameters before resolving dot-segments, such as Apache Tomcat, Jetty, WildFly, and Spring Boot, turn the segment back into a parent-directory reference and resolve it, so an unauthenticated client can escape the intended upstream prefix and reach internal paths such as admin or internal API endpoints, including with state-changing methods. CVE-2026-4950.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting in CustomerAdministration Portal (KundenManager) in VertiGIS WebOrderSystem
CVE-2026-4950.description: The CustomerAdministration portal (KundenManager) of VertiGIS WebOrderSystem allows privileged users to manage the employees of defined companies (user groups). User properties, for example the "secondName" parameter, can be filled with JavaScript code while editing a user. The code is stored and executed in the browser of any other privileged user who opens the edited user entry or the user overview of the corresponding user group. An authenticated attacker with access to the portal can use this to run script code in the session of other portal users. Version 7.0.8.6, the latest available at the time of testing, is affected. The vendor did not provide information about further affected versions.

CVE-2026-98993.title: namespace: don't inherit MNT_UMOUNT in clone_mnt()
CVE-2026-98993.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

namespace: don't inherit MNT_UMOUNT in clone_mnt()

MNT_UMOUNT gets raised on a mount that umount_tree() or umount_one() has
taken out of its namespace. It's never cleared. __detach_mounts()
unhooks a mount that carries it instead of unmounting it.

disconnect_mount() lets an unmounted child stay attached only if its
parent carries it. propagate_umount() takes it as the sign that a mount
is going to be unmounted when it decides what else can be unmounted,
where a chain of locked mounts ends and where a for reparenting an
overmount.

clone_mnt() copies the flags of the source and only masks
MNT_INTERNAL_FLAGS which doesn't include MNT_UMOUNT. A mount that was
lazily unmounted but is kept alive by a file descriptor can still be
copied when its root is an nsfs or pidfs file because may_copy_tree()
accepts those before checking whether the source is mounted at all:

CVE-2026-99121.title: ipv4: avoid divide by zero in fib_rebalance
CVE-2026-99121.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ipv4: avoid divide by zero in fib_rebalance

fib_rebalance() computes the total eligible nexthop weight in one pass
and programs upper bounds in a second pass. A concurrent change to
ignore_routes_with_linkdown can make the first pass return zero while
the second pass sees an eligible nexthop, resulting in division by zero.

If the first pass reports a zero total, set each nexthop upper bound to
-1 and skip the division. This matches the IPv6 fix in commit
d2c26c2911dd ("ipv6: avoid divide by zero in rt6_multipath_rebalance")
and preserves the lock-free rebalance path.

CVE-2026-99420.title: ovl: check that the parents of volatile/dirty are dirs
CVE-2026-99420.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ovl: check that the parents of volatile/dirty are dirs

An unprivileged user crashes the kernel by mounting overlayfs with the
volatile option.

A dentry that serves as the parent of a lookup must be a directory.
ovl_create_volatile_dirty() walks work/incompat/volatile/dirty by name,
and ovl_lookup_or_create() returns an existing entry whatever its type.
A file or a symlink that another task creates during the mount becomes
the parent of the next lookup, which calls a NULL ->lookup.

An unprivileged user mounted overlayfs with "volatile" in a user
namespace while a second process created a symlink named work/incompat,
and the mount task oopsed on a NULL ->lookup call.

Fix this by returning -ENOTDIR from ovl_lookup_or_create() when the
caller asked for a directory and the existing entry is a non-dir.

its terminator is read from the stale node, and the removed xattrs
come back after recovery.

can: raw, isotp: copy socket options outside of lock_sock()

to user space while holding lock_sock(). A copy that faults or stalls,

CVE-2026-99745.title: x86/bugs: Select the BHI mitigation based on the attack vector properly
CVE-2026-99745.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

x86/bugs: Select the BHI mitigation based on the attack vector properly

The BHI mitigation selection is inconsistent with the documentation
(attack_vector_controls.rst), which lists BHI under both the
user->kernel and guest->host attack vectors. bhi_select_mitigation()
only enables it when CPU_MITIGATE_GUEST_HOST is set; otherwise it
selects BHI_MITIGATION_OFF, even if CPU_MITIGATE_USER_KERNEL is set.

As a result, a kernel compiled with KVM disabled gets BHI automatically
disabled, since CPU_MITIGATE_GUEST_HOST defaults to off without KVM.
This is a bug, given that CPU_MITIGATE_USER_KERNEL still needs it: on
affected Intel CPUs these kernels lose BHI_DIS_S or the BHB clearing
loop by default. Booting with mitigations=auto,no_guest_host has the
same effect.

Select BHI_MITIGATION_ON whenever user->kernel is mitigated, and keep
BHI_MITIGATION_VMEXIT_ONLY for the guest->host-only case.
